content:
다음은 다항식 $6x^3-x^2+bx-3$을 $x-a$로 나누었을 때의 몫과 나머지를 조립제법을 이용하여 구하는 과정이다.
$$\begin{array}{r|ccc|c}
a & 6 & -1 & b & \multicolumn{1}{c}{-3}\\
 & & \boxed{\phantom{000}} & \boxed{\phantom{000}} & \multicolumn{1}{c}{\boxed{\phantom{000}}}\\\hline
 & 6 & 3 & 3 & c
\end{array}$$
$a+b+c$의 값은? (단, $a,b,c$는 상수이다.) [3.9점]
sourceMathEvidence: The restored source displays synthetic division for 6x^3-x^2+bx-3 by x-a: the top coefficient row is 6,-1,b,-3 and the bottom row is 6,3,3,c, with the three intermediate product cells boxed.
solutionMathEvidence: The first addition gives -1+6a=3, hence a=2/3. The next gives b+3a=3, hence b=1. The remainder cell gives -3+3a=c, hence c=-1. Thus a+b+c=2/3, matching choice ②.
